newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to present draft for a regional pact Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Spain to present draft for a regional pact Tuesday.

text.p: Spain is expected to present on Tuesday a first draft for a stability pact between the central and 17 regional governments designed to penalise fiscal delinquency after the European single currency is launched.
"The government proposal could be presented to the regions tomorrow and than it will be made public," a spokeswoman at the Secretary of Exchequer said.

The current five-year pact between the central government and the regions expires at the end of 1997, but it contains no fines or sanctions against regions which do not meet objectives on deficit or debt. -- Madrid Newsroom, + 341 585 8340
